column_description: SERIAL primary key identifying each data profile record.
CHAR(10) referencing DataFlow(RecordRegistry), linking this profile to a particular data flow.
INT referencing RiskManagement(RiskTrace). Associates the data profile with a relevant risk record.
VARCHAR(80) describing the category of data (financial, personal, logs, etc.). Currently possible values: (Commercial, Personal, Financial, Industrial, Medical).
VARCHAR(30) designating data sensitivity level (High, Medium, Low). Currently possible values: (High, Low, Critical, Medium).
NUMERIC(10,2) representing the approximate data volume in gigabytes.
BIGINT counting how many records exist in this data set or flow.
BIGINT enumerating how many unique data subjects are impacted/contained.
INT storing the retention duration (in days) for this data.
VARCHAR(80) naming the data format (CSV, JSON, XML, proprietary, etc.). Currently possible values: (Mixed, Unstructured, Structured).
NUMERIC(4,2) capturing data quality on a custom 0–100 scale.
checkstatus_enum enumerating data integrity check status. Currently possible values: (Passed, Failed, Partial).
checkstatus_enum enumerating checksum verification status. Currently possible values: (Failed, Success, Pending).
checkstatus_enum enumerating source validation status. Currently possible values: (Pending, Verified, Failed).
checkstatus_enum enumerating destination validation status. Currently possible values: (Pending, Verified, Failed).
